outgoing.name: Roman Catholic Church
outgoing.excerpt: St Patrick's church is a Catholic church located in the oldest known still standing building in the area, built in 1874.

outgoing.name: World War I
outgoing.excerpt: The Summer Hill flour mill was built circa 1922, utilising the north-south goods railway line that was constructed during World War 1.
